page.overview:
What is City?

City is a continuation of the theme released in 2003-2004. It was a subtheme of 4 Juniors and later 4+ following its rebranding.

The City part of 4 Juniors and 4+ was the main part, and a continuation of the previous and successful line (2001-2002). It featured many of the same things, including returns of several minifigures such as Jack Stone himself in 4655 Quick Fix Station and 4657 Fire Squad HQ. It consisted of several lines, including Construction, Police and Firefighters.

Category:4 Plus Category:Jack Stone Category:Themes Category:Themes introduced in 2003
